headline: Sensex and Nifty fall for second day as crude oil surge and banking drag erase early 500-point rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surging crude oil prices weighed heavily on market sentiment
Banking stocks dragged the indices down from their intraday highs
Global cues, including unrest in France and rising UK inflation, impacted investor confidence
Profit booking occurred after an initial rally of 500 points led by IT stocks
whatHappening: Sensex fell 143 points to settle at 73,709.69, while Nifty dropped to 22,811.35
IT stocks outperformed the broader market despite the overall decline in major indices
India's volatility index (VIX) surged by 6% during the trading session
The market experienced a volatile session, soaring early in the day before crashing from its highs
summary: The Indian stock market ended lower for the second consecutive session, with the Sensex falling 143 points. Despite an initial 500-point rally led by IT stocks, surging crude oil prices and weakness in banking stocks erased all early gains. Investors remained cautious due to global economic pressures and rising market volatility.
